name: INFRATEL Kitwe Disaster Recovery Data Centre
notes: INFRATEL says it operates three data centres in Zambia and markets active-active and disaster recovery services. Uptime Institute lists INFRATEL Corporation Limited - Kitwe Data Centre with Tier III Certification of Constructed Facility.

name: Paratus Zambia Data Center
notes: Data Center Dynamics reported Paratus opened a 1MW data centre in Lusaka; Paratus Zambia's current service page confirms local data centre and colocation services.

name: INFRATEL Lusaka Production Data Centre
notes: INFRATEL describes Tier III data centre operations with redundant power, cooling and connectivity; third-party listing gives 1.25MW for the Lusaka INFRATEL Data Centre, while Uptime Institute lists INFRATEL Lusaka certification.

name: INFRATEL Lusaka Backup Data Centre
notes: INFRATEL states it runs three data centres nationally; Data Center Platform separately lists an INFRATEL Data Center Backup Facility in Lusaka.

name: ZICTA / Zambia National Data Center
notes: Huawei's Smart Zambia case study describes a national data center for the government program; Data Center Platform lists ZICTA Datacenter in Lusaka.

name: NetOne IT Datacenter
notes: Data Center Platform lists NetOne IT Datacenter in Lusaka; NetOne IT's company site corroborates Zambian IT infrastructure services but public technical detail is limited.

name: MTN Lusaka Data Centre
notes: Third-party data-centre directories list an MTN Lusaka Data Centre; no current primary facility page found in this pass.

name: Liquid Intelligent Technologies Zambia Data Centre
notes: DCD reported Liquid planned data centres in Angola and Zambia; no public site or capacity was identified, so Lusaka is used as a likely national hub placeholder rather than a confirmed site.

name: Smart Zambia / Huawei AI Data Centre
notes: Developing Telecoms reported a Smart Zambia Institute and Huawei Zambia MoU supporting AI data centre development. Public reporting did not disclose a site; division assigned to Lusaka because the national digital-government institutions and existing government data-centre activity are centered there.
